106010.t: Saverim
I don't know what the hell she wants to do with the Aether she plans to extract, but...
Who does she think she is, kidnapping our people and doing whatever she wants with them? Let's go after her right now and teach her a lesson—
...If we pursue Elder Exenos in our current state, we will most likely all be overpowered.
Surprise attack or not, she is clearly far stronger than she used to be.
...What if we got some reinforcements?
I could probably round up some help with a few calls to people I know on the Quartz...
Sigh... But first we need to figure out where we're going and what we're doing...
...I believe we still have some time.
If she intends to use Believer Lumina's Aether... Elder Exenos will have to perform a [Ritual].
A ritual? Well, this is a religion we're talking about. Makes sense.
Aether cannot be transferred directly from one person to another. It requires divine intervention.
...Really?
That is why a "ritual" is needed to obtain Harmonix's permission to transfer Aether.
Traditionally, the predecessor spends several months purifying themselves and fasting, then offers a prayer to return their Aether to Harmonix.
Several days later, the successor takes up the prayer and continues the ritual...
If Harmonix is moved by their sincerity, she grants them Aether.
They just pray for days on end...?
What about eating, drinking, and sleeping...?
Through Harmonix's providence, it all works out somehow.
(Yeah, I definitely need to keep my mouth shut about being able to give and take Aura whenever I want.)
However, with Exenos... there is no telling where or how she might perform the ritual...
The Ascetic sisters of Celestial mostly use the old chapel... the one beneath the Celestial Chapel.
If she performs the ritual, I believe it will be there.
Hmm... Then we should check that place first when we get the chance.
By the way, is that purification and fasting thing really necessary?
She's already ignoring the usual procedures. I doubt she'll bother with every little detail.
Fair point, but that is how a non-believer would think.
Even as a Heretic, she seems to have kept her faith.
So... I believe we still have a little time. Besides, Aether is not so easily manipulated.
...Alright, I'm with you that far.
Wait, don't they train their bodies and minds through asceticism? Wouldn't their everyday lives already count as "purification and fasting"...?
The Ascetic sisters devote their days and nights to purifying their bodies and minds.
But an Aether ritual usually demands more than that... I suspect they will take rather extreme measures.
A large-scale purification ritual, for instance, or a separate session of group penance...
Hmm... Got it. Things are starting to come together a bit.
Guess it's time to call the others in. We need to figure out what we're doing next.
...So Celestial's former Mother Superior kidnapped Lumina for her latent "Divine Power."
Hmm... I do not know why a nun of her standing would suddenly resort to this, but I understand the situation.
Good thing she's not gonna do anything to her right away!!
Let's hurry over to Vermont! Operation Rescue Lumina is a go!
Wait, Freya. We must make a plan first.
This is practically a declaration of war. If we are to win, we must prepare.
W-War? Isn't that a bit dramatic...?
So, how did you all get to Humanitas?
We simply took the train. It is safer than crossing the Outer Belt by car.
But... there is no guarantee they will return the same way.
Right. If they took a train, Lumina wouldn't just sit there. Even she'd put up a fight...
Wait, wasn't she looking forward to her own execution ceremony or whatever?! What if she's happily tagging along because she thinks it's another chance to show off her body??
...Figures Celestial and Lumina would have something in common...
Huh? Doesn't Celestial teach that the body is God's masterpiece and should be shown off?
As far as I know, asceticism is "a practice of enduring unbearable physical pain and suffering to cultivate the mind or achieve a religious goal"...
Wouldn't scarring yourself like that go against Celestial's doctrine...?
...I never said it left scars.
Pain does not necessarily leave a scar.
Oh, right. Even getting shot barely tickles most people here...
Wait, then how do they inflict pain...?
[Pain] can take many forms.
The most reliable method is [Penance] inflicted on the body by another person... but as you know, ordinary attacks are nowhere near enough.
True enough. It's not like you guys ever really get hurt—
It seems the most common method is to use one's own body to inflict pain on another.
I am not an Ascetic myself, but I have often seen the Ascetic sisters slap each other's rear ends quite hard.
The technical term was s-s... Hmm, what was it again...?
...Spanking?
Oh, no wonder... So what I did to Spica back then was basically penance...?
Pardon?
Nothing. Are there any other kinds of asceticism?
Or does everyone just enjoy getting their asses spanked like Spica?
Of course. Striking is only one form of penance.
Some involve enduring relentless electrical stimulation, or withstanding hot candle wax...
Uh... huh...?
Others involve being tied up and seated on a vibrating wooden horse... or punching each other hard in the lower abdomen...
So it really was THAT kind of penance!!! That's all just S&M!!
Sigh... Harmonix, please forgive the sins of these impure souls...
I thought we were discussing how to rescue Sister Lumina. How did we end up talking about this...?
...Wait, they're not gonna make Lumina do that kind of stuff, are they?
If anyone's making her do it, it'll be me!! Me!!
That is not the point...!!
A-Anyway... we should book train tickets as soon as possible, or find another way to get there...
There is a shop in DD TOWN that sells [Aerosphere]-made wings. They are an older model, though, and not very stable.
Since falling a mere 50 meters will not hurt anyone, it may be worth considering.
Pretty sure I WOULD get hurt! Can we try something a little safer?
Like a teleportation machine or something...
Hmm... Or what if we ask Charlotte for help?
She's got a car, so getting to Vermont shouldn't be a problem...
Request denied. I don't want to go bankrupt.
Sure, we use our Hands-on CEO as a taxi often enough, but a trip to another city? Who knows how much she'd charge...
Yeah, good point... Hmm...
What about that technology SOS or whatever has? Can't we use that?
That... would be difficult for us to arrange.
We don't know how to use it, and SOS hasn't authorized us to... Ahaha...
Tch, figures it wouldn't be that easy...
Ugh, seriously... We're getting nowhere like this!
Can't anyone think of another way to get to Vermont quickly??
Hmm...
There may be a way... though I cannot say whether they will appear.
...? Come on, what's with the dramatic buildup—
...One moment in the east, the next in the west... They can appear in any city, at any time, without warning.
I thought perhaps they might know a way...
By any chance... have you ever heard of the Blissful Trading Guild?
Hmm...?

106020.t: Saverim
The Blissful Trading Guild... That's...
Hehe... Did you call for me, dear customer?
Whoa! Where the hell did you come from?! You scared me!
Who knows? How long have I been here, I wonder? Hehe...
Anytime, anywhere... A merchant of the shadows, appearing only to customers worthy of her wares.
Yomi of the Blissful Trading Guild! Whenever and wherever you need me, I'll be right there in a flash!
What do you need? A talisman to seal evil spirits? A Sealing Implement to control Impure Energy? Or perhaps...
No, nothing like that... We need to get a whole group to Vermont, fast...
Hey, Chise. Are you sure about this? Talismans are one thing, but transportation—
I do not know the exact details myself, but...
I have heard that each member of the Blissful Trading Guild chooses customers by their own standards, then appears just when those customers need [Merchandise].
Hehe, that's right!
Though we do follow our whims now and then!
Even I did not expect her to appear the moment I mentioned it.
I must admit, I am rather surprised myself...
Hehehe... Actually, I've had my eye on you for quite some time now, Fixer!
Ever since I heard about something falling from the sky, I've had a feeling you were someone extraordinary!
Yeah, yeah, we can skip the backstory.
We need a way to get to Vermont... Do you sell anything that could help?
Hmm, transportation, you say!
I'm afraid we can't offer our guild's secret arts to just anyone!
Of course, if it were just you, Fixer, I could find a way!
Can't you make an exception?? I'd like to bring at least a few people along, if possible.
Just in case it comes to a fight...
Hmm... Normally I'd say no, but... since you might be in danger...
There is a way, but it's going to take a lot out of me, you know?
So I'll have to charge you a hefty fee for the trip!
Whatever it takes. Just get us there.
I'll scrape the money together and pay you later if I have to.
Hmm, I haven't decided whether I want money... or something else. Hehehe...
But you can do it, right? One way or another?
Yes! I'll get everything ready right away!
Still, what a shame... I thought my creations would finally get a chance to shine...
Then again, you need me, not my wares... That has its own appeal...
...What are you muttering over there?
Nothing at all!
Now, everyone who's going with the Fixer, please step this way!
As for me... If word gets out that I have arrived in Vermont early, it may put Elder Exenos on guard...
I will stay here and keep watch over Believer Spica.
If I find a way to help rescue Believer Lumina from here, I will take it.
Hmm... Not sure if that's the best call.
You said it yourself. Taking on Exenos alone would be tough.
...I won't overdo it.
...Alright. If you say so.
Oh, and...
If you ever need the help of Celestial believers in an emergency, show them this handkerchief and give them my name.
So long as they are not Ascetics, I believe they will be able to offer some discreet help.
...I'll hold onto it for now. Just in case.
Hmm, so that leaves... Isabel, Chise, and Hiyori, I guess.
Ah... I think I should go check on my family first.
I'll probably head back to Vermont soon anyway, but it'd feel weird to just tag along without telling them...
Yeah, fair enough.
Then...
I... would like nothing more than to help, but a warrior's training must follow its destined course.
I am truly sorry I cannot leave Humanitas just yet...
Hmm... Guess there's no helping it.
I'm grateful for everything you've already done, Chise.
There is no need to thank me. I only wish I could do more...
I've got my own business to take care of, too... *Hic*...
I'll be rooting for you, though! The better things go for you, the more fun I'll probably get to have!
Something like that, anyway. Go on, give it your best shot! *Hic*...
So, is this everyone?
All right! Now, everyone...
First, please close your eyes!
And put your hands on the shoulders of the person in front of you!
...What is this, an escape room briefing—
Oh, Fixer, you can just hold on to my shoulders!
Of course, I wouldn't mind if your hands wandered elsewhere!♡
...Really?
Yes! Though if you touch me too much, I might lose focus and get us lost!
Can't have that. Nope.
Guess I'll just settle for this for now.
Oh my, what a shame.
Hehe... We'll have to save the fun for later!
Here we go, everyone! Hold on to the person in front of you, and don't panic if you hear strange noises!
From now on, keep your eyes closed! Only the Fixer can open them, since we're directly connected!
You might feel a little dizzy as we enter. Just bear with it!
All right, let's start walking!
Stay close and follow me! You could be lost forever if you don't!
If it were just one or two people, I could use a Mystic Art based on ground-shrinking to take us straight to a safe zone, but...
With this many people, that's not an option... We'll have to do it the old-fashioned way!
Even I could be in danger if I took one wrong step, and I know this place well. So be careful!
Ground-shrinking...? What are you, some kind of Taoist master?
Hehehe... I'm an artisan first, a practitioner of Mystic Arts second, and a merchant third!
I only sell my creations because I want people to love them and find joy in them...
Of course, I do sell other things now and then! I have to keep the business running somehow, right? Hehe...
Money is important, sure...
So, how much farther do we have to go?
Just a few more steps! Quick, isn't it? That's Leyline Travel for you!
You have to keep your feet on the ground, but you can travel quickly, as though the earth itself were folded up!
Of course, as I said, it's not completely safe!
We've been lucky today! Usually, Aberrant Spirits... Or would "Ghosts" make more sense to those of you from Vermont?
Usually, a whole bunch of them turns up and causes trouble, but...
Huh? I thought Ghosts only appeared when there was a Rift??
What kind of place is this if...
Wh-What the heck? Where'd that light come from?
Look too closely and you might find yourself entranced! Best to ignore it!
Think of it as the lingering thoughts of Aberrant Spirits... or the residue they leave behind!
I used to spot them caught between the leylines now and then... but I've definitely been seeing more lately!
Eek...
...How on earth did you manage to make a path through here...?
I'm afraid that's a trade secret! Hehe...
Though who knows? If we get a little closer, I might just tell you...
Yeah, yeah. Looking forward to it. Let's just keep moving.
Hehehe...
Anyway, here we are! Best to close your eyes again!
Vermont Plaza
Well then, welcome to Vermont—the land of religion, magic, and art!

106030.t: Vermont Street
Let's see... It only took us about three minutes to get here! Fast, right?
Hehehe... All that hard work was worth it!
It's not my first time in Vermont, but... I never expected we'd get here this fast.
Now we'll be ready for Exenos whenever she gets to Vermont... Thanks, Yomi.
Hehe, I'm glad you're happy... Though guiding this many people really takes it out of me...
Hey, why do you look so pale...?
Protecting this many people with a Mystic Art while guiding them takes a lot of mental energy...
Hehehe, I'll be fine after a few days' rest. Don't worry!
...Shall I arrange rooms for you at Feelharmony?
We should have room for everyone, including you, Fixer...
Um, Abbess... I don't think that's a very good idea...
The message boards are a total mess right now!
Huh? What's going on—
Apparently, some believers in Humanitas saw Mother Superior Bianca and Abbess Ines together...
Now the senior nuns have started a flame war on the boards for the first time in ages... Ahaha...
Guess they've got nothing better to do. Should nuns really be acting like that?
Tell me about it! The further you scroll, the wilder the fanfiction gets!
They're saying the two sects are finally going to war, or that Mother Superior Bianca tried to sell out Celestial to Feelharmony, and all sorts of things...
Goodness, why would nuns who serve Harmonix say such undignified things...
The head nuns leave, and everyone starts slacking off. Figures.
Nothing better to do than make up rumors online.
...So much for slipping back into Feelharmony unnoticed.
Even if we go back, it'll be hard to get ready to deal with Celestial...
Then where do we go...
Let's see... Who do I know in Vermont?
House Chronoscholar, with Yuria at its head.
Kinogarten Studio, where Valentina works as a director.
Ines's Feelharmony Monastery... probably won't work.
And Bianca's Celestial Monastery, which we've just had a run-in with... Yeah, that's definitely out.
So Feelharmony's out, from what we've just heard...
Chronoscholar would be good for lying low, but it's so cut off we'd have trouble keeping up with the news.
Kinogarten might work, but I doubt they'd want to get mixed up in all this...
...Who's calling now? We've got enough on our plate.
...Huh? Isabel? Why's she calling...
Did things go okay with her family?
Hey, what's up—
Uh, well... Looks like I'll be joining you guys sooner than I thought. Ahahaha...
As soon as I explained everything, Mom said, 'I suppose our vacation ends here, then,' and decided we were heading back!
So the whole family is flying back to Vermont together right now!
...Flying?
Oh, basic flight magic like this is a breeze for anyone in my family, you know?
Looks like Mom's using her flight magic to bring Gin and Aronne along, though...
Hey, if it's that easy, I would've just asked you to fly us back!!
What?! Flying on your own and carrying someone with you are two completely different things!!
Besides, using flight magic on other people takes someone as good as my mom! Even I can't do that...!
O-Of course, I could probably manage if it was just you, but...
*Sigh*...
Figures. That's our little lightweight for you.
I-I'm not a lightweight!!
*Sigh*... Anyway! Don't go wandering off. Head straight to Bloody Mary!
I already said I'd help you. I'd look pretty bad if I didn't see it through!!
Hmph!
Well, looks like we know where we're going.
Bloody Mary it is, then... but how long till they get here?
...The average demon flies at about the same speed as a mid-sized wing unit from Aerosphere.
An archdemon like Elisia could normally fly as fast as the latest wing models, but she is carrying two people...
Even at a conservative estimate, they should reach Vermont within a few hours.
Well, look at that! Theta's actually doing her job for once—
My brain's battery is depleted. Requesting a bread resupply.
...Figures.
Wait, Ines... If all demons can fly, then you...
Don't tell me you could fly this whole time and kept quiet so you wouldn't have to carry us?!
Flight magic isn't that easy...! It takes exceptional magical skill.
Besides, I've never even had proper magic lessons... A-and why would you expect a nun to know that sort of magic...!
Okay, okay, I get it. Teasing you really never gets old.
Th-That's a most impure thought...

106040.t: Bloody Mary
Hmm. Takes a lot of confidence to go on vacation and leave your door unlocked.
Is there nothing worth stealing, or is this a warning that we'll regret it if we try...?
I will lay Yomi down somewhere suitable.
Then I shall check the kitchen for bread.
Oh, then I wanna see if they have a study!
A mansion like this has gotta have at least a couple of good books, right?
The owners will be back soon. Don't go poking through their stuff and getting us in trouble. Just stay put.
They'll walk in and think we're a bunch of bread and book thieves.
You clearly do not understand. Vermont is home to many bakeries with a long and rich history.
It is practically a holy land for bread.
So what?
To leave such bread uneaten would be a breach of etiquette.
It would be no different from telling the host, 'Your home cooking tastes awful.'
Pretty sure that only applies when you refuse or throw away bread the host actually gave you...
Enough with the ridiculous excuses. Go lay her down somewhere first.
And if the bread here is so great, why are you living in Humanitas anyway?
What? Why are you looking at me like that?
...Now that I think about it, there is no particular reason. I have simply stayed there.
Humanitas has excellent bread as well.
With no memories of my past, I have no reason to tie myself to any one place.
...Right. You did say you'd lost your memories.
Lumina's with the Church of Harmonix, and Freya's always bragging about being from the Humanitas Back Alley, but you...
I know I am from Aerosphere. It says so on my parts.
Beyond that, I know nothing... except that 'Theta' was inscribed on my Gear.
...Uh, I hate to interrupt the talk about Theta's past, but...
Shouldn't we lay Yomi down somewhere first? Dragging her across the floor like this is a bit...
Hehe, please don't mind meeee!
Ugh, I think she's seriously starting to lose it.
Anyway, I'll buy you some bread later. Just find something to do till then.
And don't go barging into someone else's study without permission, either!
...What are you guys doing?
Ahh... Harmonix... Please forgive us for setting foot in this impure place once again...
There's no crowd, no drinks, no music... What's all the fuss about?
What's even here to tempt you?
It's not any one thing. The whole place is the problem...
If we stay here, surrounded by all this sin...
Eventually, the line between good and evil will blur... We'll start accepting things we would once have condemned...
Ahh, this place is a sanctuary of corruption...! Harmonix, give me the strength to resist these Urges...!!
...Well, good luck with that.
We meet again sooner than expected.
I hear someone from your office was kidnapped by Celestial. Is that true?
Yeah, that's right. Didn't you hear all about it from Isabel?
I did, though Isabel has never been terribly good at explaining things.
She told me what happened, but left out all the details.
That's our lightweight royal candidate for you. Soon I'll be adding 'socially awkward' to her list of titles.
Wh-Who are you calling a lightweight...!! And I'm not socially awkward, either!
It was urgent, so I stuck to the important bits! Why are you picking on me?!
Anyway, enough about that.
Would you mind if we stayed here for a while, Elisia?
Of course not. You're welcome to stay.
We have enough spare rooms for everyone to have their own.
That leaves the question of room and board...
Asking to stay for free would be pushing it, huh?
Hehe... Isn't that obvious?
They say those who do not work shall not eat, after all...
How about helping out around the bar?
Hehehe... A bar hiring Feelharmony nuns, even temporarily—now that's a first.
...I-I knew it... I had a bad feeling about this...
Ahh, Harmonix... Why must you put me through such trials...
...That actually sounds kinda fun?
I've never done anything like this before... I'll have to post about it when I get a chance!
Must be nice being so carefree, Lucia...
Well, as long as I have time to practice my martial arts, I can't complain...
Oh, by the way, you're banned from social media until we get Lumina back.
We came here so word wouldn't get out on the nuns' community board. Don't tell me you were planning to post an update to promote yourself...?
Eek...! Y-You devil! Even a real one wouldn't be this cruel!!
That's a pretty rude thing to say right in front of demons.
Besides, what good would it do to tell everyone you're working here?
...I mean, true, but... *Whine*...

106050.t: The next day...
Bloody Mary
Welcome back, dear guests. It has been a while since your last visit.
Yeah, the professors have been racing through the material lately... It's all I can do to keep up!
Today's my chance to kick back and enjoy what little free time I have!
I see. Then I shall make you something light and refreshing.
Is there a particular flavor or aroma you would like?
Oh, then I'll have the sweet and tangy one I usually get!
Something with a really rich, fruity flavor!
Th-Then I'd like something rich and milky... Something with a slightly sweet chocolate scent, maybe...
Of course. I recently acquired something rather special.
How about some limited-edition milk from the master chocolatier 'Chocola'?
Th-The milk they use in that legendary milk chocolate? The one that's always sold out...?!
Whoa... You managed to get some?!
Man, should I change my drink too...? Now I'm torn...
Take your time. There's no rush. Also... we're offering a special service today.
Normally, Lady Elisia is the only one offering counseling for an extra fee with your drink, but...
Today, you can also choose our 'Confession Course' or 'Fixer Course'.
Confession...? Fixer...??
Never mind the Fixer one... Confession? Like at the Church of Harmonix?
Hehehe... Shall I explain?
L-Lady Elisia?!!
W-We haven't even signed up for counseling yet...!!
As the mistress of Bloody Mary, I'm happy to do this much for my guests... Hehe.
Everyone is welcome to find comfort and pleasure here, but...
Unfortunately, it seems many followers of the Church of Harmonix do not see it that way.
To be fair, we haven't had the staff or the services to cater to followers of the Church of Harmonix...
So, for a limited time, we're offering something new for guests who prefer a slightly more 'reverent' atmosphere.
Ooh... I had no idea you'd put so much thought into it...
That's Mama Elisia for you...!! A mother to everyone who walks into this bar...!!
Hehe, I already have two grown daughters. At this rate, I'll soon have plenty more!
Man, I really am a genius. I don't know how I even came up with this.
A few dark rooms turned into Confessionals, the nuns' identities safely hidden, and all the Church of Harmonix gossip we could want...
(I even put up two layers of blackout curtains so only their lips or cleavage show through. But I'll keep that part to myself.)
If I'd known it'd go this well, I would've put Theta and Freya in nun habits and stuck them in rooms too.
There are so many customers, I had to come help out...
What's so great about it, anyway...
You're missing the point. It's anonymous, so they can say whatever they want.
No matter how much nonsense they spout, the person on the other side has to sit there and listen to every word.
That's not how confession works, as far as I know, but... whatever...
So, what about the Fixer service?
That one... flopped. Nobody's signing up for it.
Tch. That was supposed to be my big plan to make some extra cash... Damn it.
What about you? Why the long face?
Aaaah... I can't do this anymore... I'm completely worn out...
How can there be this much work...? Someone save this poor demon...
Quit whining. Gin handles several times your workload and she's completely fine.
You're supposed to be a king someday. How can you have so little stamina?
Ugh... I'm too tired to argue, and you're still finding ways to annoy me...
Gin's an Android... She might be less durable than a regular person, but she can get several times as much work done...
Aronne's no help with this stuff, so all the leftover work falls to me...
What a lightweight. If you're gonna build a kingdom, you should be able to handle this much work.
What kind of king hauls luggage around all day and washes dishes for four hours straight!!
Kings get busy, sure, but not like this!!
Shows what you know. The fewer subjects you have, the more work you'll have to do yourself. Lead by example, right?
Well, you look so miserable, I might as well lend you Theta and Freya.
For a fee, of course! You're borrowing my staff, after all!
You're supposed to be working off your room and board, and you're still trying to squeeze more money out of us...
Besides, those two break so much stuff, we'd be better off not putting them to work at all...
Hey, my girls might be clumsy and careless, but when it's time to work, they get the job done.
Just look at Freya and Theta. They've been running around nonstop together lately.
Yeah! I've been keeping busy!
Walking all over Vermont, meeting people, picking up rumors!
And handing out flyers for this event all over the neighborhood!
Correct. I am also diligently sampling the local bread.
Few bakeries can match Butter Bloom, but Vermont truly is a holy land for bread and Western cuisine.
Yeah, you can take it easy on that last part.
So, is there still no news about Celestial?
According to Lucia, there is still no news on the nuns' network, and no word of Exenos.
If she were back in Vermont, word would have spread. Something must have delayed her return with Lumina.
Did they book too late...? Or did we just get here way too early...?
Did we even need Yomi's secret art, then?
Still, it gave us time to establish a basic intelligence network.
I did not expect to encounter them in Vermont, but it was fortunate that we did.
Tell me about it... We ran into a lot more familiar faces than I expected.
Hehe, I didn't expect to run into you here either, Fixer!!
...Same here, Reanna.
So, what brings you to Vermont?
Ahaha, funny you should ask!
My producer told me to look into [Studio Rousseau] because their stock price has been acting strange lately!
I've been doing a lot more exposés lately. Other companies besides Midwen Corporation have been looking suspicious too... Sigh...
Rousseau... Isn't that the handbag company? Seems like everyone has one...
Not that I'd know much about it, since I have no reason to buy one.
Hehe, that's part of what they do!
[Studio Rousseau] specializes in developing and selling magitech products. Their handbag division just happens to be the most popular!
My bag's from Studio Rousseau too! It's only from their budget line, though.
It can hold a lot more than you'd think, and you barely feel the weight at all!
Hmm... If they sell other kinds of bags, maybe I should get one...
So, what does that have to do with us?
Ah, well, you see...
Allow us to explain that part.

106060.t: Bloody Mary
We are martial artists of the Fairwinds Association and members of the Orchid Clan!
I am Dan Xi, a carefree wanderer with a taste for the finer things in life! And this here is...
...Do I really have to?
Hoho, you know nothing, Kouchou.
Make a grand entrance, and people will remember you fondly!
Come now! Chest out! Don't be shy!
Priestess of the Red Butterfly, Kouchou...
Hmm, I can barely hear you!
Is that all the spirit you can muster—
Hey, quit making a scene in someone else's place of business...!!
Hmm? Ah, do people not do that in Vermont?
My apologies, then. Ahahaha!!
...You pulled the same stunt when you kicked our door down! And now you're doing it again?!
At this point, you're just doing it on purpose, aren't you??
...Heh. It's all part of living in style...
Ahahaha! Let's not dwell on such trivial things, my friend.
...You call everything trivial whenever you don't have an answer, don't you?
By the way, weren't you sick from that evil energy last time? Are you feeling better now?
...Yeah. The priests helped me recover. I'm fine now...
But everything from before that energy hit me is hazy... like it's all lost in a fog...
I know I was sent to investigate signs of a Rift... I followed traces of Impure Energy all the way to Humanitas.
But what I did there, where I went, who I met... I can barely remember...
...Well, if you can't remember, maybe it means it wasn't all that important?
We met in Saverim around the time we were working that job for Midwen Corporation, didn't we?
I'm sure it was something important. Something I needed to report to The Four Seasons...
...It's frustrating.
Hmm, I sensed no sign of a Rift in Humanitas...
Well, it's nice to catch up and all...
But what were you going to tell us about [Studio Rousseau]?
Hmm. I hear the company's leadership is in an uproar over who should control it.
Apparently, the sole heir ran away from home a few years ago and never came back.
An heir?
Is that a big deal here in Vermont? First Elisia, now this Rousseau company.
Hehe, it's much the same everywhere.
Many parents hand an established family business over to their daughter, then stay on to help behind the scenes. More than you'd think.
...Though some do leave it all behind to chase a new dream.
In any case... another organization is trying to buy the group outright, or at least acquire a stake in it...
Have you heard of the Aurelius Family?
Nope. From the name, I'm guessing they're obsessed with gold...?
Ahaha, you're not wrong! After all, their current head is the chairwoman of the Merchant Guild, Dorothea Aurelius.
She runs the Aurelius Group. She's a tycoon with enormous influence over the flow of Credits in Vermont and every city around it.
How do you know all this? I thought you ran a stock channel?
Well... when my producer first got into investing, she looked into companies in the Aurelius Group...
Did she get burned?
No... It wasn't that.
More like she couldn't get burned even if she wanted to... How do I put this...
...? What do you mean?
When she saw that the stock price of their flagship company, Aurelius Holdings, was approaching 1,000,000,000 Credits per share, she was completely floored...
She still rants about why they won't do a stock split whenever she gets the chance...
1,000,000,000 per share?! What kind of company is this?!
That was her exact reaction!
Oh, you really should meet my producer sometime... I think the two of you would get along great!
Ahem... Right. Enough about stocks.
Can we get back to your explanation? Sum it up in three lines.
Ah... Right! I'll keep it short.
When the heir ran away, the head of the Russo Family had to scrap her plans and take charge of all their businesses again.
Then, as financial problems piled up, the Aurelius Group offered to buy shares and help run the business.
But the head of the Russo Family didn't want another company gaining too much influence, so she turned them down. Now there's a power struggle going on behind the scenes... That's the gist of it!
...Okay, I follow.
But what does any of this have to do with us?
We're here to rescue a friend who was kidnapped by a Celestial elder, remember? Not to go handbag shopping.
Right. That's the connection.
A recent leak from Studio Rousseau says they're releasing a new bag inspired by the Church of Harmonix...
There's also a rumor that they're planning a huge donation to get the Church of Harmonix's backing.
Word is they're quietly seeking support from both Feelharmony and Celestial...
But apparently, all the nuns of abbess rank at both Feelharmony and Celestial have been away since we arrived.
People are even wondering if the Aurelius Group is behind it—if they kidnapped them or forced them into another city.
...Hmm. Is that so?
Apparently, that's made the Russo Family work even harder to find their heir.
Some say they already know where she is, but can't catch her because she's always on the move!
Well, the Russo Family specializes in Spatial Magitech Engineering. Their heir isn't going to be easy to track down!
...Spatial... expansion?
Everything has been loaded into the back, Fixer.

There is actually enough room inside for all twenty people...
It is remarkable that such technology exists.
I thought it was amazing at first too, but it really is handy.
I'd love a bag like this. Don't they sell these on their own?
...If you bring me all the materials, I could make you a small one.
The only problem is... someone has a tight grip on the distribution of those materials.
Who is it? If necessary, I can—
No. Don't. It's fine. Please just leave it alone.
Hmm... So that's what that was about?
Did that ring a bell, Fixer?
...No, something just came to mind...
So the Russo Family and the Aurelius Family have gotten themselves into a pretty tangled mess, right?
And they're trying all sorts of things to rope the Church of Harmonix into it, but it's not going the way they want.
Yes, exactly!
So if an Abbess—or someone close to that rank—comes back to Vermont...
With all those people and companies waiting to make their move, it's bound to cause a stir!
Hmm...

106070.t: Bloody Mary
Another day or so passed...
The confession event at Bloody Mary was a huge hit. The Fixer event? Still dead quiet.
No one had a clue that the three nuns hearing confessions in the dark back room were from Feelharmony.
It wasn't that different from their usual work, so the nuns didn't have much to complain about...
Was this the moment we'd been dreading...?!
Fixer? I'm afraid I have some bad news...
Hmm? What's wrong?
Well... there's a post on the nuns' bulletin board, and apparently Exenos is due back in Vermont today.
Finally...? How is that bad news?
I was starting to wonder if she'd ever show up.
No, that's not the bad part...
Bianca was trying to track Exenos down on her own in Humanitas... She was ambushed.
Huh...? Wasn't she supposed to stay put in Humanitas so Exenos would let her guard down?
It seems... she had other plans.
I don't know if she felt responsible for failing her mission, but...
Apparently, she took matters into her own hands in Humanitas and got caught.
She must have gone after Exenos alone to buy us time, or get some information...
...So what's happening now?
It seems the Celestial nuns went to Saverim and took Bianca into custody after she was teleported there. They even took Spica, who was being held there...
They say she's unconscious, under the "protection" of Exenos and the Celestial nuns.
Ugh, that idiot... Bianca said herself that a small group wouldn't be enough. Why did she go off on her own...?
Bianca's... always been like this.
Maybe she's too stubborn for her own good, or she takes her responsibilities too seriously... Sigh.
She's not... in danger, right?
Now that the other nuns know, harming Bianca would only cause trouble. I doubt they'll lay another finger on her.
But if they manage to steal Believer Lumina's Aether... what happens to Bianca and me after that...
Either way, we need to deal with Exenos soon.
From what I've heard, Elder Exenos is set to become Acting Mother Superior if nothing changes. Things just keep getting worse...
Can they just make someone Acting Mother Superior whenever they want...?
She was Mother Superior once before... And the Church of Harmonix has so many problems to deal with right now.
And then there's the feud between the Russo Family and the Aurelius Family... Sigh...
All I wanted was to serve our goddess faithfully. Why does everything have to be so complicated...
Do you have any ideas?
I think I need to go to Sanctus Sedes.
Now that even Bianca has been captured, we need to move quickly.
I don't see any other way out of this... We may need Saintess Vesperi herself to step in.
By yourself? Shouldn't you take someone with you?
Ah, Lucia and Airen will stay with you. Matters of Aether are confidential, and you may still need their help gathering information...
...All right. Thanks for everything you've done for us.
You go do what you need to do. We'll handle our end.
Yes. I shall pray to Harmonix... that only light awaits you, Fixer.
Well then.
Ugh... This is getting way bigger than I expected. What are we supposed to do...
Phew... What good is all my martial arts training if I can't use it now?
Actions speak louder than words! I should march right in and give each of those sacrilegious jerks a good smack over the head...
Then it's up to us to do something.
...? Do what, exactly...
...Sneak into Celestial ourselves.
And get everyone out... Lumina, Bianca, all of them.
Sounds great... but how are you gonna do it?
I don't think barging into the Celestial Chapel and picking a fight is gonna solve anything.
Of course not. Why would I pick a fight I know we can't win?
This is where we use our heads.
Do you have a plan?
First, tell me what the Celestial Chapel's like, and what the girls there are into.
I need something to work with before I can come up with a plan.
Uh... Have you ever been to a club in Humanitas?
...No? Not since I got here.
Do you think I have the money for that?
Ah, well, no problem! A lot of Vermont's clubs are connected to Celestial!
Actually... hehe... you have to keep this a secret, okay...?
I snuck into their chapel a while back for a secret prayer meeting with a few Celestial girls...
...Some secret. You posted all the photos on social media.
Anyway, I had no idea that place belonged to Celestial.
Ahahaha!
W-Well! It's not like the nuns at Celestial and Feelharmony hate each other!
Apart from the ones who take it really seriously, or a few of our more eccentric Ascetic friends...
We interpret the doctrine differently, but we all follow Harmonix!
Sometimes we get together for little mixers. You know, "love and peace" and all that!
...Do Ines or Bianca know about this?
N-No... The older nuns don't really use the community boards much...
We just kept using it, and I guess nobody really noticed... Ahahaha...
...All right. Your secret's safe with me.
So, how does that help us?
Oh, right! I think I know a way into the Celestial Chapel!
I'll need Airen's help, though... and I have a feeling she won't like it...
...?! W-What is it, Lucia?!
Why are you looking at me like that?!
Hmm... Oho...
Now I'm interested.

106080.t: Celestial Chapel
I've never been to this chapel before, but...
This is just a club, isn't it??
They said the chapel would be packed today. There sure are a lot of people here who aren't nuns...
Isn't it normally like this...?

Well, I am not sure.
I have never been to a club.
By the way, is there no bread?

Don't expect to find bread in a place like this...
Actually, they might serve some at the bar.
Anyway, what's with you?
Mmm, it's nothing.
I just saw someone who looked familiar...

Focus, focus.
Once we're inside, the whole plan hinges on you.

Seriously, what's taking those two so long??
How long does it take to get changed?
Oh, come on, Airen! Stop fussing and put it on properly!

You already agreed to wear it!
You can't back out now!

Th-That's not it, okay?!
I just don't know how to put this thing on!!
You don't just drape it on like that—pull it tight! Tight!
I-It's just strings! What am I supposed to tighten?!
I'm a nun of Feelharmony! I can't wear something this indecent...!
This is the bare minimum if you wanna hang out at Celestial!
Or you could wear something like my outfit!
Th-That's not even clothing! It's just belts! Belts!
At least I can pretend this one's a swimsuit, but...!
Come on, belts make great outfits!
Besides, I picked out something much simpler for you, Airen!
If you can't even wear this, what are you gonna wear?!
...What are you two doing?
We've been waiting for ages out here.

Ah, sorry!
Airen keeps getting embarrassed!
We're getting changed in a public restroom nearby. Just give us a little longer!
Sheesh. They really won't let us see those outfits until they're wearing them.
Apparently, even showing them to us beforehand would be too embarrassing...
Hehe, the wait is part of the fun!
It's even given me a few new ideas for Sealing Implement designs!
I know, right? I've picked up some great material too!
With so many people connected to the Russo Family here, I've got plenty of material to work with!
Yeah, I figured you two had your reasons when you insisted on tagging along.
All these people and electronic devices are making my ears sting a little, though!
Guess you can't just turn that ability on and off whenever you want.
I can turn the volume down a bit, but I can't mute it completely!
I'm used to it now, though. It's just white noise to me! Hehe...
...By the way, are you really okay?
First there was that teleportation, then you made us talismans, and now you're coming along too.
We asked for the talismans, sure, but you didn't have to come out here yourself.
Hehehe... Are you worried about me?
You're going to rescue a friend! I can't just sit around doing nothing!
I'm fine! I've had plenty of rest, and I can use my Mystic Arts again. Well, a little!

I whipped up those 'Perception-Blocking Talismans' in no time, didn't I?
See? I'm right as rain!
Perception-blocking... Wasn't there a Perception-Blocking Cloak too?
Those Unsigned guys used them before...
Oh, their work is lovely too! Each piece is a work of art, stitched by hand!
But those Lesser magic tools... They look like they came straight off an assembly line. *Sigh*...
Mere mass-produced goods... How dare they...
If you're making something for someone, you should put your heart and soul into it...
...Yomi?

Oh. Ahaha!
I-It's nothing!

For a second, I felt like I'd glimpsed a bottomless abyss...
Let's not go there.

Ugh, it's so loud.
What's all the commotion—

Whoa, isn't that Lucia from Feelharmony?
What's she doing at Celestial...?!

I-Is there some kind of party today?
I didn't hear anything about one...!
H-How should I know?! But this is our chance...! Lucia's a huge star here at Celestial too...!!
Ah, I'm more of an Airen fan... She's so toned! Airen, take meeee!!! And show me your panties while you're at it...!!

Guess she really is an internet idol, huh?
Look how popular she is.
Hehe... She's already popular. Add my talisman to the mix, and what did you expect?
Yeah... We really pulled out all the stops for this.
Bedroom

Phew...
So, what's this favor you need?
You're asking a delicate beauty who's barely out of bed for a favor?
Who's a delicate beauty? Who?
Oh my, how mean! Hehe...
Well, I suppose 'delicate' was a bit of a stretch!

Oh, it's nothing major...
I just heard you know all about hexes and Mystic Arts!
So... could you use a Mystic Art to make someone hard to notice or remember?
Hmm, certainly!

But are you sure?
A follower of Harmonix relying on Mystic Arts...
Ehehe... Well, there's no rule against it, so it should be fine, right?

Besides, aren't Mystic Arts and magic all part of the goddess's providence...?
Something like that, right?

Hmm, that's one way to look at it...
Ahaha!
Still, I don't give or sell my creations to just anyone!
But if the Fixer here is buying, I'll be happy to help!
Alright, I'll buy them.

Oh my, that was quick.
What made you agree so easily for once...?
By the way, how do you plan on using them?
Well, one of my companions... Actually, make that a fellow Fixer and a nun I'm close to...
Anyway, they both got captured by those Celestial folks.

They're probably locked up somewhere in the Celestial building...
We're going in to rescue them.
Oho... So it's serious, then?
And you need Mystic Arts to sneak in?
Yep! We'll need enough for the Fixer and everyone going with him.

Airen and I won't need any.
We'll be helping out another way.
*Sigh*... Why do I have to be dressed like this...

So how exactly are you helping?
Are you ever gonna tell me?

Hehehe! Well...
Airen and I aren't exactly high up in Feelharmony...
And since I'm an official influencer for the Church of Harmonix, I keep in touch with some of the Celestial girls!
So if we go in and get their attention, you should have a much easier time sneaking around, Fixer!
Your influencer gig is official? That's a surprise. But how are you planning to get their attention?

How do you think? With eye-catching outfits!
The kind that turn everyone's heads!

Even I'm not sure I can pull off the outfits those Celestial girls like...
But this matters, so I'll do what I have to!
Still, even with us distracting everyone, someone might recognize you and your friends as Lumina's associates, right?
Hmm... Will Mystic Arts alone be enough, though?
Even I might struggle to use my Mystic Arts at full strength in a chapel brimming with Harmonix's Divine Power!
At best, they'll blur your faces a little and keep people from noticing you straight away...
Hehe... I've thought of that too!
I saw on the bulletin board that lots of Russo Family guests are coming to the next service. The place will be full of outsiders.
There are all sorts of rumors about huge donations and VIP treatment. Who knows how much of it's true, but...
With so many outsiders around, we should be fine even if the talismans aren't at full strength!
Aha! I see.
For something like that, I could easily make each of you a talisman, but...
This sounds like something I simply can't miss!
Huh??

...This is working better than I expected!
I didn't think they'd get this much attention.
Guess that's an influencer for you...
They're stealing the show! It's working like a charm!
Ooh, it looks like fun over there, though...

Focus, will you?
Theta, can you detect Lumina?

I know you can sense more than bread, okay?
Don't try to get out of it.
...Understood.
However, this requires considerable energy. Please ensure I am properly resupplied afterward.
Yeah, yeah, all the bread you can eat. Just get on with it.
...I will hold you to that.

106090.t: Celestial's Old Underground Chapel
This way. Lumina's signal is coming from below.

However...
The signal is too faint to pinpoint her exact location.

I figured we'd just search the whole place, but...
What is this creepy place?

They've got all kinds of creepy stuff down here.
An iron maiden, a wooden horse...
Hmm... They certainly look like torture devices!

But... hmm.
None of them look as sharp as I'd expect.
My sewing needles are sharper than these!

I guess they'd only tickle someone who can deflect bullets.
Look at all these long awls lying around...
Gah! That scared me! What the heck is this?!

...An awl-shaped vibrating device...
Hmm. I believe it is a massager for relieving muscle tension.

Look at that drawer.
They all have name tags, so I assume each Ascetic has at least one...
Hmm, it doesn't look like an acupuncture tool...
I imagine it could loosen up more than just muscles! Hehe...
Hmm, that beeping tells me this little guy runs on electricity too...

Um, it keeps mentioning a sticky, warm, dark cave...
What could it mean? Hmm...
...Whatever their idea of asceticism is, it sure isn't normal...
Aren't they just a bunch of pleasure-seeking posers?!
Hmm, this is squishier than I thought!

The tip is blunter than I expected, too...
Why is it damp?
There are a whole lot of these things, too.
And that room in the corner has even more suspicious-looking tools...
A gold mine... Wait, no. That's not what I meant.

I-It's nothing!
Why are you looking at me like that?
Anyway, Lucia and Airen can't stall forever. Let's find them and get out of here.
By the way, Theta, can't you sense Exenos or Bianca?
I have yet to get a clear lock on Exenos's Wavelength.
However, I should be able to track Bianca's Wavelength.
But like Lumina's, it is extremely faint...
Hmm... This is proving difficult.

If we had something of Bianca's...
That would make her much easier to find.
Something of hers? Like what?
Hmm... Something she carries with her, or something that has recently touched her body.

Everyone has a unique Wavelength.
My sensors identify it and track it.

Strangely, Lumina's and Bianca's Wavelengths are barely detectable...
It is almost as if they have been cut off.
A more primitive method is therefore required.
That only brings one thing to mind... Don't tell me...
Indeed... By scent.
That's way too primitive! What are you, a bloodhound?!
Do not misunderstand. Unlike you, <:player>, I do not bury my face between people's legs and sniff around.
...When have I ever done that??

Have you forgotten?
The day you first fell here, you did it to Lumina...
Ugh, I told you I had no control over that...!

We're getting off topic again!
What does scent have to do with Wavelengths?!

Everyone's scent is slightly different, correct?
If I read and amplify its Wavelength...
Energy with similar Wavelengths connects, making it easier to detect.
For the record, androids and cyborgs also have unique Wavelengths that I can read this way...

...Hmm. Never mind.
I was about to get sidetracked again.
In any case, do you have anything belonging to Lumina or Bianca?
For Bianca... Let's see...
Actually, I still have the handkerchief Bianca gave me before we left for Vermont.
Will this do?
Yes, thank you.
*Sniff, sniff.* *Sniff, sniff, sniff*...
...You look like a pervert when you do that.
My intentions are pure, so it does not matter.
I should be able to locate Bianca's Wavelength if I concentrate.
And as for an item of Lumina's...
Did we not once go looking for Lumina's underwear together?
No, that never happened.

Is that so?
Hmm... Never mind, then.
We did, but we never found it in the end.
Hmm. I seem to have jumped to conclusions.
Why are you bringing that up now?
...I simply wondered if you might have been holding on to Lumina's underwear all this time.
Oddly enough, <:player>, you carry a scent similar to Lumina's.
Oh, that must be it.
What do you mean by 'that'?
You know, when I first fell into this world, I got pinned under Lumina's butt.

Ah, yes.
You buried your face between her legs and thoroughly enjoyed yourself, did you not?
What are you talking about? You were face-down with your butt in the air, muttering about bread...

Anyway, my face was jammed between her thighs!
I think some of her sweat even dripped into my mouth...

...Have you not washed since then?
Or brushed your teeth...
Of course I have!!

Hmm...
Well, the reason is irrelevant.
Then, if you will excuse me.
*Sniff, sniff.* *Sniff, sniff, sniff.*

Hey... I can feel your breath.
Aren't you a little too close?
...I must be this close to tell Lumina's scent apart from yours, <:player>.

Why are you so flustered?
Think of all the bread we have shared.
You've eaten way more bread than I have, you little rascal.
That may be true.

Thank you.
Now I should be able to find her Wavelength easily...

Her Wavelength continues beyond this wall.
In that case—
This way. Let us hurry.

106100.t: We found the secret door, but I did not expect us to get stuck here.

What secret door?!
You just smashed through the wall where you sensed the energy!

It is fine.
With all that noise upstairs, no one would have noticed.

Still, my detector is working normally, yet...
We seem to be walking in circles.

A labyrinth...?
Or some kind of formation...?

It doesn't feel like a barrier made with hexes or Mystic Arts...
Perhaps it's magic, or [something] even older!
Hmm... I suspect we've wandered into some [Ruins]!

Ruins?
This just looks like an ordinary basement.
Hehe, [Ruins] don't always look like crumbling ancient buildings!
Knowing how many times this area has been redeveloped might give us a clue!
Oh, I know about this!

It's an urban legend, but...
Apparently, dozens of ancient civilizations vanished from this world without a trace!
They say most ancient ruins are buried deep underground...

I guess the locations are just that good, because people keep building cities in the same places...
Then they start digging and find traces of what used to be there!
...Really?
Then what about that weird statue monster we fought? Was it a relic of the past too?
Well, I heard the story in Humanitas, so it's possible!
Either way, all the local Fixers will get together and wipe it out again!
That's wild. Back where I'm from, people would bend over backward to preserve relics, but here you have to exterminate them...

Anyway, are these really Ruins?
I'm not getting that vibe at all.

Ruins don't have to look mystical!
Especially if the whole place was bulldozed during redevelopment, right?
Of course, redevelopment doesn't erase the Mystery that has seeped into the land.
Think of Ruins as places where things happen that neither science nor magic can explain!
Alright, let's say that's true.

Then what kind of Mystery is keeping us here?
How do we get to Lumina?
Hmm... It seems just strong enough to keep us wandering around the same spot forever.
You can go back the way you came, but you can't move forward until you meet a certain condition...
Something like that, I think.
How can a Mystery be this lame and this annoying at the same time?

It'd be perfect for hiding something, though...
Isn't it dangerous?

It is like a password.
Without the right answer, you cannot pass...
Still, we're lucky these Ruins seem stable!
Most people rush off to explore Ruins and ancient sites, hoping to find treasure. Personally, I wouldn't recommend it!
You'll come back empty-handed about 99% of the time!
...Why's that?
Because a [Rift] is very likely to open in Ruins like these.

I don't know how Aberrant Spirits and Ruins are connected...
But history shows that they are!

There are some magnificent Ruins in northern Quartet...
And wouldn't you know it, that's where Rifts appear most often!
The warriors there certainly have their hands full!
Learning all kinds of new things today...

Anyway, enough of that!
Let's figure out how to get through this labyrinth.
Ruins or not, finding Lumina and Bianca comes first.

Hmm...
We'll just have to try everything we can!
There's probably some condition we need to meet... An action, or perhaps a ritual...

A hidden magic circle in the center of the hallway?
Uh-huh...
From the entrance: Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, B, A...
Hmm, wait. What are B and A...?
Oh, the nipples...
...What are you talking about?
Who are you talking to?
Oh, this security camera felt sorry for us wandering around and started whispering to me.
I don't quite get the left breast, right breast part, though...

Oh, we're supposed to squeeze each one once?
How does that even work...
Who designed a labyrinth that makes you enter the Xnami Code with your boobs?!!

...Huh?
What-nami?
Ah, it's nothing...
...I don't know who designed this place, but they're clearly not right in the head.

So, you just have to touch your chest? Want a hand?
I'm pretty good with a controller—
Oh, no, not like that! You have to bounce and shake your own breasts, then press your nipples at the end...
Hmm... Someone with a smaller chest wouldn't be able to do that...

Um... I guess that means...
I should do it... right?
In the end, we left Reanna to deal with the deranged system.

Ugh...
All that bouncing made my chest hurt...
Still, I'm glad the producer isn't here to see this!
She'd say something nasty, like, "Those uselessly <bouten>huge</bouten> lumps of fat finally came in handy!"
Now I kinda want to meet this producer of yours—

Hoho...
Teleportation, is it?

And my, my...
This hallway has quite a different atmosphere!

Lumina's energy is stronger.
She is definitely here.

And she is not alone.
One... No, it seems there are two others.

One of them is... unconscious, or extremely weak.
Their Wavelength resembles Bianca's.

And the last one is...
Ugh.

Unmeasurable.
What is this...
...No idea what it is, but I guess we'll have to charge in and find out.

But it isn't Exenos, right?
Then we'll figure something out.
Yeah! We outnumber them, Exenos isn't here, and we can catch them by surprise!
Whatever that person's deal is, we'll manage somehow!
...Understood.
Then I will lead the breach.

106110.t:
That completes...
the final preparations.

I look forward to what comes next.
Hehehe...
All the sisters will be together again.
And this cycle will soon come to an end...
The only unknown is the star that fell from the sky...
A being filled with the power of the [True God]... Mother's creator, who shaped this world...

Hmm, already?
That was fast.

I should expect no less from the star...
Sooner than expected, but nothing I hadn't accounted for.

Well then, until we meet again.
I wonder what forms we'll take next time... Hehe.

What the... Hey.
You're awake?
Actually, from the looks of you, did you just wake up...?

Oh, you're right!
Ahahaha!

I was having such a strange dream!
I can't really remember it, though...

A little scary...
But exciting too... Something like that...
What're you even talking about?

Let's get out of here first.
I have no idea where we are. Let's hurry home.
Huh? Home?
B-But I still haven't had my execution debut...
Ugh, is that all you care about?!

Ask Bianca! She's right next to you!
See if she'll do it!!
Huh?
Why is the Mother Superior here...?!

How should I know?
